entities.summary: The First Dominican Republic was a predecessor of the currently existing Dominican Republic, and began on February 27, 1844, with the proclamation of the Dominican Republic, and culminated on March 18, 1861, with the annexation of the country to Spain. During these 17 years the nation was economically and politically unstable due to prior war against Haiti and internal conflicts. There were 8 governments.
